name: JW Marriott Marquis Hotel Miami
positioning: JW Marriott Marquis Miami, a downtown Miami hotel in the Financial District with a stainless-steel sky pool, an indoor golf school and a spa high above the city
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown Miami base near the Port of Miami, Kaseya Center and the museums
Golfers and basketball players who want to practice during a city stay
Guests who want a spa and well-equipped gym with bay views

facts.text: The hotel is in downtown Miami's Financial District, near the Port of Miami, Kaseya Center, Wynwood, the Frost Science Museum and the Perez Art Museum.
The hotel has easy access to the Miami Design District and Brickell.
Rooms include a work area, an espresso machine and high-speed Wi-Fi.
Beds have custom duvets and cotton-rich linens.
Enliven Spa & Salon offers couples' spa treatments, massages and facials.
Enliven's wellness programs blend movement, mindfulness and energy healing.
The fitness center has Technogym equipment, weights and a yoga studio.
Guests working out at the Met2 Fitness Center have views of the bay.
Boulud Sud is Chef Daniel Boulud's Mediterranean restaurant at the hotel.
Intermezzo Coffee Bar is partnered with illy coffee and carries the Artisti del Gusto designation.
The hotel is an AAA 4-Diamond Approved Hotel.

highlights.text: The hotel has a stainless-steel sky pool.
The Mariano Bartolome Golf School offers lessons with swing analysis, a putting green and a full 18 holes on an indoor golf simulator.
The hotel has an NBA-approved basketball court.
The Presidential Suite has views of Biscayne Bay and the city center.
Enliven Spa & Salon is on the 20th floor of the hotel.

considerations.text: South Beach is a short drive from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes that the urban setting may lack beachfront access.
